properties.name: Generation Lab
properties.description:
**Irina Conboy** — Generation Lab, Berkeley, CA (US)

Longevity diagnostics company co-founded by Irina Conboy (UC Berkeley bioengineering), combining a cheek-swab test with proprietary techniques to measure molecular markers of biological aging and disease risk.

[[https://www.generationlab.com/about|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Instituto de Nanobiotecnología (NANOBIOTEC)
properties.description:
**Instituto de Nanobiotecnología (NANOBIOTEC)** — Universidad de Buenos Aires (UBA) / CONICET, Buenos Aires (AR)

Joint UBA-CONICET institute for applied biotechnology, with a laboratory dedicated to 'Nanobiointerfaces and Biopharmaceutical Nanotechnology' addressing nanomedicine applications, alongside protein engineering, biofabrication, and biocatalytic-process research. Also runs a specialized Antarctic-microbiology program studying extremophiles for biotech applications.

[[https://nanobiotec.conicet.gov.ar/home/|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Nanobiotix
properties.description:
**Nanobiotix** — Nanobiotix, Paris (FR)

Publicly traded (Euronext: NANO, Nasdaq: NBTX) nanomedicine company developing NBTXR3, a nanoparticle radioenhancer -- CE-marked since 2019 for locally advanced soft tissue sarcoma across 27 European countries under the brand Hensify, with an ongoing Phase 3 head and neck cancer program. Incorporated 2003, headquartered in Paris.

[[https://nanobiotix.com/|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Senseonics — Eversense
properties.description:
**Senseonics — Eversense** — Senseonics, Incorporated, Germantown, MD (US)

Makes Eversense, a fully implantable continuous glucose monitor -- the sensor itself sits under the skin (not just a shallow patch like most CGMs) paired with a rechargeable Bluetooth transmitter and smartphone app. Eversense 365 lasts a full year per implant, the longest duration in the CGM market.

[[https://www.senseonics.com/|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Laboratory for Nanomaterial-Based Devices (LNBD)
properties.description:
**Hossam Haick** — Technion – Israel Institute of Technology, Haifa (IL)

Develops artificial olfactory systems based on nanosensor arrays -- the NA-NOSE (Nano Artificial NOSE) -- that detect volatile organic compound biomarkers in breath at single-parts-per-billion sensitivity. An AI-paired nanoarray version can distinguish 17+ diseases from breath samples, including several cancers, kidney disease, Parkinson's, and Alzheimer's, at up to 86% accuracy. Commercialized via spinout NaNose Medical.

[[https://lnbd.technion.ac.il/|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: Australian Institute for Bioengineering and Nanotechnology
properties.description:
**Australian Institute for Bioengineering and Nanotechnology** — University of Queensland, Brisbane (AU)

Integrated multidisciplinary research institute (500+ researchers/staff) spanning bioengineering and nanotechnology across five research pillars: stem cell ageing and regenerative engineering, precision nanomedicine, advanced materials, agriculture nanotechnology, and advanced biomanufacturing. Hosts BASE, Australia's largest mRNA vaccine/therapy manufacturing facility.

[[https://aibn.uq.edu.au/|Group website]]

Category: Nano-Medicine · Smallest demonstrated: unknown

properties.name: El-Sherbiny Nanomedicine Lab — Center for Materials Science
properties.description:
**Ibrahim M. El-Sherbiny** — Zewail City of Science and Technology, 6th of October City (EG)

Designs and develops smart nanomaterials -- polymeric, metal-organic-framework, and core-shell nanostructures -- for controlled drug delivery, tissue engineering, and biosensing. El-Sherbiny is Founding Chairman of the Nanoscience Program and Director of the Center for Materials Science at Zewail City, with 260+ papers and ~25 patents; elected Fellow of the African Academy of Sciences.

[[https://www.zewailcity.edu.eg/main/content.php?lang=en&alias=ibrahim_m._el-sherbiny|Group website]]
